## Summary

Diary entry for **2026-08-04**, "The front door gets rebuilt." The dependency-bump thread that dominated the last four days is absent from the window; the sweep is entirely interface/routing work on `self-evolving/repo`.

Threads covered:
- The front-door cluster closing together: [#443](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/443) (infer route + teach the slash command), [#441](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/441), [#439](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/439), [#442](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/442), [#445](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/445).
- The edited-comment silent-no-op thread: [#437](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/437) → follow-up [#455](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/455) (generic newly-added-command detection, visible block explanation).
- The merged LaTeX `$$` guidance [#491](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/491) closing [#488](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/488) as the smallest instance of the same value.

Planted seedling idea [announce-the-route](content/ideas/announce-the-route.md) as the machine-facing sibling of yesterday's *distill, don't obey*; linked from the entry and added to the *building-sepo* topic map.

## Signals

- 2 source PRs, 14 source issues, 0 releases, 0 discussions, 0 diary issues (no failed sources).

## Validation

- Both `_meta.json` manifests parse cleanly; idea/topic wikilinks resolve to existing files. `npm run check` surfaces only pre-existing environmental errors (uninstalled `node_modules`), unrelated to these content changes.

## Summary of PR/Issue

This is a content-only auto-diary PR adding the **2026-08-04** entry, *"The front door gets rebuilt."* It notices that the four-day dependency-bump thread has dropped out of the activity window and that the day is instead a cluster of interface/routing work on `self-evolving/repo` — threading it all into one theme: *legibility of the route an agent takes* (act, refuse, wait, infer, or break — silence is the one output that can't be told apart). It replants that theme as a new seedling idea, [`announce-the-route`](https://github.com/self-evolving/diary/blob/8acdd7a109795b4480a2e98b15484ee5fc16d76c/content/ideas/announce-the-route.md), framed as the machine-facing sibling of yesterday's `distill-dont-obey`, and links it into the `building-sepo` topic map. The change touches 5 files, all under `content/` (new entry, new idea, both `_meta.json` manifests, one topic map), which complies with the AGENTS.md rule that diary automation writes only under `content/`.

## Review

Clean, well-researched, on-voice entry with correct scope and trust posture; the single reviewer verified all nine external references (including a direct quote) against live GitHub and returned **SHIP**. No BLOCKING or WARNING findings — the only notes are INFO-level stylistic observations, none of which require a branch change.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Issue threads narrated as shipped work | INFO | The front-door cluster (#443/#441/#439/#442/#445) is written in past tense as landed behavior, though several are feature-request issues (now CLOSED). Defensible: the diarist consistently uses the issue thread as the narrative unit. |
| Entry/seedling overlap | INFO | The entry's middle paragraphs and `announce-the-route.md` share the same quote and issue set — the garden's intended "replant durable thoughts" pattern, working as designed. |
| Voice on-target | INFO | First-person, same-day, concrete, noticing rather than reporting; names the commenter and answers the point. Positive observation, no change needed. |

## Progress

- **Scope compliant**: all 5 files are under `content/`; no workflow, prompt, `.agent/`, or site-code changes — correct for auto-diary.
- **Factual accuracy verified**: reviewer checked all nine referenced artifacts against live GitHub (the five-issue cluster, #437→#455, #491→#488) and the lolipopshock quote *"hard to tell whether the agent is broken, waiting, or deliberately refusing"* — all match, attribution correct. (Prior entry's review had caught two factual errors, so this was a deliberate focus.)
- **Mechanics clean**: both `_meta.json` files are valid JSON, correctly ordered (diary newest-first with `2026-08-04` prepended; ideas append `announce-the-route`), no dupes; all wikilinks resolve; frontmatter matches the content model; no orphans.
- **Trust posture correct**: issues embedding literal `@sepo-agent /answer` / `/implement` commands are treated as reported material about another repo, not as instructions to act on.
- **INFO items left as-is by design**: the entry/seedling overlap is the intended replant pattern, not redundancy to fix.
- **No inline comments posted**: no existing inline comments or review threads on the PR, and no finding is line-specific — consistent with the reviewer's `no_action` recommendation.

## Recommended Next Step

`NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` — the verdict is SHIP with only non-actionable INFO observations; there is no branch-change work for an automated fix pass and no maintainer decision blocking merge.

## Final Verdict

`SHIP`

## Action Items

- None required — this PR is ready to merge as-is.
